name: Tio
source:
She is a candidate for the president of the Republic of Lancelot.

[spoiler]She is the caretaker for the girls secretly taken in by the Kingdom of Eden that became outlaws from unfortunate circumstances. She took up the responsibility upon herself because of how her deceased little sister was raped which resulted in her becoming an outlaw. Her little sister was irrationally robbed of her normal life because of it.[/spoiler]
